title: AS2: for-in break leaks remaining enumeration keys on AVM1 stack
description: When break fires inside a 'for (var k in obj)' loop, the break-patch jumps to loopEnd (after the exit ActionPop). At that point all remaining unprocessed keys and the undefined sentinel pushed by ActionEnumerate2 are still on the stack. Subsequent code runs with a polluted stack. The same issue exists in compileLabeledForInStmt. Fix: emit stack-cleanup (ActionPop in a count-based loop, or a while-not-undefined loop) before the break target, or track the enumerated count and emit that many pops. Location: packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts lines 866-927 and 1403-1441.
